name: Legend Electronics
old_description: Our company's objective is to continually improve in all aspects of our business through a customer-oriented quality management system. We are committed to ensuring that this policy is understood and implemented throughout the organization.
about:
Legend Electronics is an independent stocking distributor of electronic components based in Hawthorne, New York. Founded in 1991, the company has operated as a global sourcing partner for new and obsolete semiconductors, integrated circuits, relays, connectors, switches, and Mil-Spec components.

The company maintains a live inventory of 34,422 part numbers across 40,127 lots, with each lot listed separately including date code, country of origin, packaging, and RoHS status. Beyond stocking, Legend Electronics provides shortage management, cost reduction, excess inventory management, MRP support, last-time-buy fulfillment, and end-of-life product sourcing. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

Legend Electronics serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), contract manufacturers, and repair depots across the electronics industry, including aerospace and defense customers requiring Mil-Spec components. The company emphasizes personal service, assigning each customer a dedicated sales contact to manage requirements from bill-of-materials support to emergency shortages.

The business was built on the ability to source hard-to-find, allocated, or discontinued components quickly, leveraging global supplier relationships and a lot-level traceability system that gives buyers full visibility into what ships.
